title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jahmyr Gibbs shreds tough Vikings defense in Week 8 win
items.desc: Jahmyr Gibbs carried the ball 23 times for 153 yards and one touchdown while also catching two of his four targets for 15 yards in the Lions' 19-15 Week 8 win over the Vikings.
items.impact: Gibbs has had a nose for the end zone of late, rushing for one or more touchdowns in four of his last five contests. The running back remains an explosive RB1 option entering a favorable Week 9 matchup against the Miami Dolphins.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jared Goff held in check in Week 8 win
items.desc: Jared Goff completed 18-of-25 pass attempts for 176 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in the Lions' 19-15 Week 8 win over the Vikings.
items.impact: Goff was mostly held in check by a stout Minnesota defense, finishing with under 200 passing yards for the first time this season. The quarterback will look to get back on track in a favorable matchup against the Miami Dolphins in Week 9.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown hauls in seven passes in Week 8 win
items.desc: Amon-Ra St. Brown hauled in seven of his team-leading eight targets for 46 yards while also rushing once for 10 yards in the Lions' 19-15 Week 8 win over the Vikings.
items.impact: St. Brown was held in check by a stiff Minnesota defense, recording less than 50 receiving yards for the first time in his last four contests in the win. The wideout remains a stable WR1 option entering a favorable Week 9 matchup against the Miami Dolphins.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jameson Williams finds end zone in Week 8 win over Vikings
items.desc: Jameson Williams hauled in four of his six targets for a team-high 70 yards and one touchdown in the Lions' 19-15 Week 8 win over the Vikings.
items.impact: Williams has had a nose for the end zone of late, registering one or more receiving touchdowns in each of his last three games. The wideout remains one of the more explosive offensive options for head coach Dan Campbell entering a juicy Week 9 matchup against the Miami Dolphins.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Sione Vaki logs 12 touches in Week 8 win
items.desc: Sione Vaki rushed 11 times for 65 yards while also catching his only target for five yards in the Lions' 19-15 win over the Vikings in Week 8.
items.impact: Vaki was impactful for the first time in a forgettable season, recording over 60 rushing yards for the first time in his seven contests. The running back remains best left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 9 contest against the Miami Dolphins.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Sam LaPorta quiet in Week 8 win
items.desc: Sam LaPorta caught three of his five targets for 33 yards while also rushing once for two yards in the Lions' 19-15 win over the Vikings in Week 8.
items.impact: LaPorta has struggled to make an impact on offense of late, recording less than 35 receiving yards in each of his last two contests. The tight end will look to get back on track against an underwhelming Miami Dolphins defense in Week 9.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Tyler Conklin catches pass in Week 8
items.desc: Tyler Conklin caught his only target for seven yards in the Lions' 19-15 win over the Vikings in Week 8.
items.impact: Conklin remains a non-factor in the Detroit offense, finishing with less than two targets in each of his five contests. The tight end can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 9 contest against the Miami Dolphins.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Kyler Murray offers mixed results in Week 8 loss to Lions
items.desc: Kyler Murray completed 17-of-29 pass attempts for 210 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception while also rushing four times for a team-high 35 yards in the Vikings' 19-15 Week 8 loss to the Lions.
items.impact: Murray battled hamstring tightness late in Sunday's contest, recording less than 230 passing yards for the third consecutive contest. The athletic quarterback faces a stiff test in Week 9 against the Buffalo Bills.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Justin Jefferson finds end zone in Week 8 loss to Lions
items.desc: Justin Jefferson hauled in five of his nine targets for 33 yards and one touchdown in the Vikings' 19-15 Week 8 loss to the Lions.
items.impact: Jefferson made the most of an otherwise forgettable performance, scoring a touchdown for the second time in four contests despite recording less than 45 receiving yards in three of his last four contests. The wideout has fallen victim to underwhelming quarterback play to this point ahead of a Week 9 matchup against the Buffalo Bills.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jordan Addison leads pass-catchers in Week 8 loss
items.desc: Jordan Addison hauled in three of his eight targets for 66 yards in the Vikings' 19-15 Week 8 loss to the Lions.
items.impact: Addison has battled inconsistent involvement in the Minnesota passing attack, finishing with under 70 receiving yards in two of his last three contests. The wideout remains difficult to trust ahead of a Week 9 matchup against the Buffalo Bills.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jordan Mason bottled up in Week 8 loss
items.desc: Jordan Mason rushed eight times for 20 yards in the Vikings' 19-15 loss to the Lions in Week 8.
items.impact: Mason struggled to find running room in a losing effort, finishing with under 50 rushing yards for the first time in three contests. The running back remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 9 contest against the Buffalo Bills.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: T.J. Hockenson reaches end zone in Week 8 loss
items.desc: T.J. Hockenson hauled in four of his five targets for 58 yards and one touchdown in the Vikings' 19-15 Week 8 loss to the Lions.
items.impact: Hockenson has had a nose for the end zone of late, recording a receiving touchdown in each of his last two contests. The tight end will look to continue his impactful stretch against the Buffalo Bills in Week 9.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Aaron Jones Sr. held in check in Week 8 loss
items.desc: Aaron Jones Sr. rushed five times for 22 yards while also catching both of his targets for 18 yards in the Vikings' 19-15 Week 8 loss to the Lions.
items.impact: Jones Sr. has struggled to make an impact out of the backfield of late, rushing for less than 30 yards in each of his last two contests. The running back faces another stiff test against the Buffalo Bills in Week 9.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jauan Jennings quiet in Week 8
items.desc: Jauan Jennings caught both of his targets for 11 yards in the Vikings' 19-15 loss to the Lions in Week 8.
items.impact: Jennings has been minimally involved in the Minnesota passing attack to this point, finishing with under 35 receiving yards in each of his six contests. The wideout remains difficult to trust ahead of a Week 9 contest against the Buffalo Bills.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Ben Yurosek sees two targets in Week 8
items.desc: Ben Yurosek caught one of his two targets for 24 yards in the Vikings' 19-15 loss to the Lions in Week 8.
items.impact: Yurosek has seen minimal involvement in the Minnesota offense, finishing with less than three targets in each of his three games. The tight end can be left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 9 contest against the Buffalo Bills.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: DeeJay Dallas sees one touch in Week 8
items.desc: DeeJay Dallas rushed once for four yards in the Vikings' 19-15 loss to the Lions in Week 8.
items.impact: Dallas has been a non-factor out of the backfield, finishing with less than 10 rushing yards in each of his seven contests. The running back can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 9 contest against the Buffalo Bills.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Dak Prescott records two touchdowns in Week 8 loss to Cardinals
items.desc: Dak Prescott completed 19-of-29 pass attempts for 195 yards and one touchdown while also rushing seven times for 20 yards and one touchdown in the Cowboys' 33-30 loss to the Cardinals in Week 8.
items.impact: Prescott was unable to find consistent success Sunday, finishing with under 200 passing yards for the first time in his last seven contests. The quarterback will look to get back on track against a leaky Indianapolis Colts defense in Week 9.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Javonte Williams bottled up in Week 8 loss to Cardinals
items.desc: Javonte Williams carried the ball 24 times for 56 yards while also catching one of his two targets for one yard in the Cowboys' 33-30 Week 8 loss to the Cardinals.
items.impact: Williams was held in check out of the backfield, failing to reach the end zone for the first time in his last six contests. The running back will look to get back on track against a generous Indianapolis Colts defense in Week 9.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: CeeDee Lamb leads pass-catchers in Week 8 loss to Cardinals
items.desc: CeeDee Lamb hauled in seven of his team-high 11 targets for 58 yards in the Cowboys' 33-30 Week 8 loss to the Cardinals.
items.impact: Lamb was held mostly in check Sunday, finishing under 60 receiving yards for the first time in his last three contests. The wideout remains locked in as an elite WR1 option against a generous Indianapolis Colts defense in Week 9.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: George Pickens quiet in Week 8 loss to Cardinals
items.desc: George Pickens caught two of his four targets for 48 yards in the Cowboys' 33-30 Week 8 loss to the Cardinals.
items.impact: Pickens has fallen back to earth of late, finishing under 60 receiving yards in each of his last two contests. The wideout will look to take advantage of a generous Indianapolis Colts defense in Week 9.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Ryan Flournoy finds end zone in Week 8 loss
items.desc: Ryan Flournoy caught three of his four targets for 38 yards and one touchdown while also rushing once for three yards in the Cowboys' 33-30 Week 8 loss to the Cardinals.
items.impact: Flournoy has had a nose for the end zone of late, scoring a touchdown in two of his last three contests. The wideout remains a touchdown dependent option in all formats ahead of a favorable Week 9 contest against the Indianapolis Colts.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Brevyn Spann-Ford catches four passes in Week 8
items.desc: Brevyn Spann-Ford caught four of his five targets for 31 yards in the Cowboys' 33-30 loss to the Cardinals in Week 8.
items.impact: Spann-Ford remains an afterthought in the Dallas offense, finishing under 40 receiving yards in each of the first eight contests. The tight end's value remains tied to the health of No. 1 option Jake Ferguson ahead of a Week 9 contest against the Indianapolis Colts.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Tyler Goodson quiet in Week 8
items.desc: Tyler Goodson rushed seven times for 14 yards while also catching both of his targets for 19 yards in the Cowboys' 33-30 loss to the Cardinals in Week 8.
items.impact: Goodson remains minimally involved out of the backfield, rushing for less than 40 yards in each of his six contests. The running back can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 9 contest against the Indianapolis Colts.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Jets D/ST allows 38 points in Week 8 loss
items.desc: The Jets D/ST allowed 247 passing yards, 95 rushing yards, and 38 points in a loss to the Raiders.
items.impact: The Jets' defense tallied one sack, but failed to force any turnovers in the loss. The Jets' defense will face a tough test in Week 9 against Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Jason Sanders perfect in Week 8
items.desc: Jason Sanders connected on 4-of-4 field goal attempts and 3-of-3 extra point attempts in a 38-33 loss to the Raiders.
items.impact: Sanders connected on field goals from 21, 31, 36, and 39 yards out. This was a much needed bounce back performance after the 30-year-old had a costly miss last week. Sanders and the Jets will take on the Chiefs in Week 9.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Kenyon Sadiq hauls in one pass in Week 8 loss
items.desc: Kenyon Sadiq caught 1-of-2 targets for 22 yards in a 38-33 loss to the Raiders.
items.impact: Sadiq and Mason Taylor continue to split time in the Jets' offense, impacting their weekly fantasy value. Sadiq and the Jets will take on the Chiefs in Week 9.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Mason Taylor hauls in three passes in Week 8
items.desc: Mason Taylor caught 3-of-5 targets for 19 yards in a 38-33 loss to the Raiders.
items.impact: Taylor and Kenyon Sadiq continue to split time in the Jets' offense, limiting each of their value. Taylor and the Jets will take on the Chiefs in Week 9.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Isaiah Williams finds the end zone in Week 8 loss
items.desc: Isaiah Williams caught his lone target for an 18-yard touchdown in a 38-33 loss to Las Vegas.
items.impact: Williams found the end zone early in the second quarter. Williams is likely fourth on the depth chart for the wide receivers, so fantasy managers can temper expectations heading into a matchup with the Chiefs.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Adonai Mitchell finds the end zone in Week 8
items.desc: Adonai Mitchell caught 7-of-9 targets for 142 yards and a touchdown in a 38-33 loss to the Raiders.
items.impact: Mitchell turned in a career performance just one week after being blanked on the stat sheet. The 24-year-old found the end zone on a 12-yard reception in the second quarter and logged a team long 47-yard reception in the fourth quarter. Mitchell and the Jets will take on the Chiefs in Week 9.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Omar Cooper Jr. not targeted in Week 8 loss
items.desc: Omar Cooper Jr. did not record a target in a Week 8 loss to the Raiders.
items.impact: Cooper had logged back-to-back 100-yard performances, but was not a factor at all against Las Vegas. Adonai Mitchell saw an increase in playing time and that clearly had an impact on Cooper's playing time.  Cooper and the Jets will take on the Chiefs in Week 9.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Garrett Wilson hauls in six passes in Week 8
items.desc: Garrett Wilson caught 6-of-12 targets for 83 yards in a 38-33 loss to the Raiders.
items.impact: Wilson led the team in targets and was second on the team in receptions and receiving yards. This marked his second highest target total of the season, which he needed after being targeted just three times last week. Wilson and the Jets will travel to Kansas City in Week 9.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Braelon Allen excellent in Week 8 loss
items.desc: Braelon Allen rushed for 147 yards and a touchdown on 21 carries in a 38-33 loss to the Raiders. He caught both of his targets for six yards.
items.impact: Allen set a new career high in rushing yards and has been excellent as the starting running back with Breece Hall (quad) out for the fifth straight game. Allen has tallied over 100 rushing yards in three of those five games and will likely remain a key part of the Jets' offense in Week 9 against the Chiefs.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Gardner Minshew II tosses three touchdowns in Week 8 win
items.desc: Gardner Minshew II completed 17-of-23 pass attempts for 188 yards and three touchdowns in the Cardinals' 33-30 Week 8 win over the Cowboys.
items.impact: Minshew II took advantage of an opportunity behind center after No. 1 signal caller Jacoby Brissett was benched, leading the Cardinals to a comeback victory Sunday. The quarterback could be in line for an opportunity to start against a tough Seattle Seahawks defense in Week 9.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Geno Smith tosses late interception in Week 8 loss
items.desc: Geno Smith completed 20-of-32 passes for 290 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception in a 38-33 loss to the Jets. He added four rushing yards on one carry.
items.impact: Smith found Adonai Mitchell and Isaiah Williams in the second quarter to account for his two touchdown passes. Smith has struggled with the turnovers as of late, tossing an interception in three straight games. Smith and the Jets will take on the Chiefs in Week 9.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Tyler Allgeier dynamic in Week 8 win over Cowboys
items.desc: Tyler Allgeier carried the ball 11 times for 147 yards and one touchdown while also hauling in all five of his targets for 44 yards and one touchdown in the Cardinals' 33-30 Week 8 win over the Cowboys.
items.impact: Allgeier took advantage of an Arizona backfield attack that lost Jeremiyah Love and Bam Knight, rushing for over 50 yards for the first time in his last seven contests. The running back could be in line for a sizeable workload if both Love and Knight remain sidelined for a Week 9 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Raiders D/ST allows 33 points in Week 8 win
items.desc: The Raiders D/ST allowed 290 passing yards, 166 rushing yards, and 33 points in a win over the Jets.
items.impact: The Raiders' defense tallied two sacks and one interception in the win. Neither defense really did anything of note in this game, with both teams scoring over 30 points. The Raiders did score on special teams, with Dylan Laube returning a 95-yard kickoff for a touchdown in the second quarter. The Raiders will take on the 49ers in Week 9.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Matt Gay perfect in Week 8 win
items.desc: Matt Gay connected on his lone field goal attempt and 5-of-5 extra point attempts in a 38-33 win over the Jets.
items.impact: Gay connected on his lone field goal from 53-yards out late in the fourth quarter. The 32-year-old had missed two field goals over his last three games. Gay and the Raiders will take on the 49ers in Week 9.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Trey McBride finds end zone in Week 8 win over Cowboys
items.desc: Trey McBride hauled in seven of his eight targets for 72 yards and one touchdown in the Cardinals' 33-30 Week 8 win over the Cowboys.
items.impact: McBride has had a nose for the end zone of late, recording a receiving touchdown in three of his last four contests. The tight end remains locked in as a reliable TE1 option ahead of a Week 9 matchup against a tough Seattle Seahawks defense in Week 9.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Michael Mayer hauls in five passes in Week 8
items.desc: Michael Mayer caught 5-of-6 targets for 53 yards in a 38-33 win over the Jets.
items.impact: Mayer and Brock Bowers led the Raiders' pass catchers, accounting for 16 of Kirk Cousins' 26 pass attempts. Mayer remains a solid option in deeper leagues with the Raiders' continuing to deploy both tight ends.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Kendrick Bourne quiet in Week 8 win
items.desc: Kendrick Bourne caught one of his two targets for 29 yards in the Cardinals' 33-30 win over the Cowboys in Week 8.
items.impact: Bourne exited with a right ankle sprain in Sunday's win, finishing with less than six targets for the first time in four contests. The wideout's status will need to be monitored throughout the week ahead of a Week 9 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Brock Bowers finds the end zone twice in Week 8 win
items.desc: Brock Bowers caught 7-of-10 targets for 92 yards and a two touchdowns in a 38-33 win over the Jets.
items.impact: Bowers found the end zone in the first and third quarters and just missed on another touchdown in which he was tackled at the one. Bowers has recorded  at least 70 receiving yards in six straight games, marking the first time that feat has been accomplished by a tight end in NFL history. Bowers and the Raiders will take on the 49ers in Week 9.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Devin Duvernay catches two passes in Week 8
items.desc: Devin Duvernay caught both of his targets for 14 yards in the Cardinals' 33-30 win over the Cowboys in Week 8.
items.impact: Duvernay has been a non-factor in the Arizona offense to this point, seeing his first targets of the season Sunday. The wideout can remain off rosters in all formats entering a Week 9 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Jalen Nailor hits pay dirt in Week 8 win
items.desc: Jalen Nailor caught 4-of-4 targets for 38 yards and a touchdown in a 38-33 win over the Jets.
items.impact: Nailor found the end zone on a two-yard reception early in the fourth quarter to give the Raiders the lead. This marked his best game of the season, setting a new season-high in receptions and logging his first touchdown of the season. Nailor and the Raiders will take on the 49ers in Week 9.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Bam Knight quiet in Week 8
items.desc: Bam Knight rushed three times for eight yards while also catching one of his two targets for 10 yards in the Cardinals' 33-30 win over the Cowboys in Week 8.
items.impact: Knight was unable to find much success prior to exiting with an injury, recording less than 25 rushing yards in seven of eight contests. The running back's status will need to be monitored ahead of a Week 9 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Tre Tucker held without a catch in Week 8 win
items.desc: Tre Tucker did not record a reception on his lone target in a 38-33 win over the Jets.
items.impact: Tucker's one target marks a new season low for the 25-year-old. Jalen Nailor was the only wide receiver on the roster that logged a catch in the high-scoring affair with the Jets. Tucker and the Raiders will take on the 49ers in Week 9.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Elijah Higgins catches two passes in Week 8
items.desc: Elijah Higgins caught two of his four targets for 10 yards in the Cardinals' 33-30 win over the Cowboys in Week 8.
items.impact: Higgins has seen minimal involvement in the Arizona passing attack to this point, logging less than 30 receiving yards in seven of eight contests. The tight end can be left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 9 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Mike Washington Jr. sees 25 rushing attempts in Week 8 win
items.desc: Mike Washington Jr. rushed for 83 yards on 25 carries in a 38-33 win over the Jets.
items.impact: Washington saw 25 carries to Ashton Jeanty's two rushing attempts in the win. Head coach Klint Kubiak stated after the game that the reduced workload for Jeanty was by design. Fantasy managers should expect Washington to continue to be involved in the running game heading into Week 9 against the 49ers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Reggie Virgil sees two targets in Week 8
items.desc: Reggie Virgil failed to catch either of his two targets in the Cardinals' 33-30 win over the Dallas Cowboys in Week 8.
items.impact: Virgil has seen minimal involvement in the Arizona offense to this point, recording targets in two of his four contests. The wideout can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 9 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Ashton Jeanty sees just two carries in Week 8 win
items.desc: Ashton Jeanty rushed for nine yards on two carries in a 38-33 win over the Jets. He caught 3-of-4 targets for 64 yards.
items.impact: Jeanty saw the bulk of the rushing attempts go to Mike Washington Jr. in the win Sunday. After the game, it was made clear that this was the plan and was communicated to Jeanty prior to the game. Fantasy managers will want to monitor reports from the Raiders heading into Week 9.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Simi Fehoko catches pass in Week 8
items.desc: Simi Fehoko caught his only target for 17 yards in the Cardinals' 33-30 win over the Cowboys in Week 8.
items.impact: Fehoko has been an afterthought in the Arizona offense to this point, registering his first reception in seven contests Sunday. The wideout remains best left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 9 contest with the Seattle Seahawks.
